question: 有效订单GMV最高的5个卖家是谁
generated_sql:
SELECT 卖家ID, 成交总额 FROM (
  SELECT 
    seller_id AS 卖家ID,
    gmv AS 成交总额,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC, seller_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      foi.seller_id AS seller_id,
      SUM(foi.price) AS gmv
    FROM fact_order_item foi
    JOIN fact_order fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
    WHERE fo.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY foi.seller_id
  ) AS agg
) AS ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
validated_sql: SELECT 卖家ID, 成交总额 FROM (SELECT seller_id AS 卖家ID, gmv AS 成交总额, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC, seller_id ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT foi.seller_id AS seller_id, SUM(foi.price) AS gmv FROM fact_order_item AS foi JOIN fact_order AS fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id WHERE NOT fo.status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY foi.seller_id) AS agg) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 5 LIMIT 500
